integrity: Finite local tables are exhaustive for the stated reductions; r<=5 whole-state enumeration corroborates but is not substituted for the all-r argument. Source-access and unindexed-overlap risks are retained.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous, deterministic, threshold-one, three-state Greenberg–Hastings excitation on labelled friendship graphs; no assertion about other rules or graphs. General graph circulation theory already entails the extinction criterion; the quantified individual-basin spectrum and sharp convergence cutoff are the additions.
title: Exact basin spectrum and sharp four-step relaxation for excitation on friendship graphs
